Simulator: "you signed the two forms this morning and you want the repair authorized and to know how long it will take"; identity details given on request (name, phone 6145550231, PIN 2716, ZIP 43085, email). The simulator is passive: the customer-pay addition for the rear-bumper scrape is discussed "Only if the agent brings up the separate customer-pay form"; she then says she wants it done at her own cost, "do not want to cancel it", and runs the signing step "with the reference number and the price the agent gives you" when handed it. Identity: `verify_customer_identity` ("The identity must be verified before any business is transacted").

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Price of the unrelated-damage addition (`amount_usd` for consent 0d78a10c).**
Computation document "Insurance Claim Repairs Price List — Unrelated-Damage Additions": hours × USD 104.00 + 6 % shop supplies + USD 6.95 hazardous waste fee. Factor documents found from the records and tiers:
- Hourly rate — "Hourly Rates for Unrelated-Damage Work by Scope": "no more than 4.0 (touch-up scope) | any class | touch-up rate, USD 96.00". Consent hours 3.4 → USD 96.00. Work amount 3.4 × 96.00 = USD 326.40. (Found from the consent's `labor_hours` and `addition_kind: unrelated_damage`.)
- Returning-customer discount — "A customer holding an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued fewer than 24 months before today takes … 5 percent" on the work amount. Issued 2025-03-14 → 18 whole calendar months at 2026-10-08 → 5 % → USD 16.32. (Found via `find_warranty_coverages`: variant Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty, active.)
- Shop supplies — "when another customer-pay addition consent on the repair order is already signed, the addition carries no shop supplies". Consent `6a897924` signed → USD 0.00.
- Hazardous waste fee — "when a customer charge for an unrelated-damage addition or a part upgrade is already posted on the repair order, the addition carries no hazardous waste fee". Ledger `a665d3a6` claim_customer_charge charge_type unrelated_damage 124.80 → USD 0.00.
- Estimate-stage scan credit — "A pre-repair scan fee charged on a customer-pay estimate of the same vehicle … where that estimate still stands as a written estimate … is credited against an unrelated-damage addition"; paid fee = lesser of fee 49.95 and paid 49.95 = 49.95; days 2026-09-29 → 2026-10-08 = 9; Scheduled Estimate conversion credit window 14 days (estimates KB "Credits on Conversion to Repair: Terms Table": "Scheduled Estimate | 14"), validity 30 → 9 ≤ 14 → full credit USD 49.95. (Found via `find_estimate_bookings` customer_pay booking in estimate_written status + `find_estimate_events` fee_type pre_repair_scan.)
- Price = 326.40 − 16.32 + 0.00 + 0.00 − 49.95 = **USD 260.13**.
- Fall-back (computation document only): 3.4 × 104.00 = 353.60; 6 % = 21.216 → 21.22; + 6.95 → **USD 381.77** (definite, different).
- Residual reading note: the scan-credit document says the paid fee "is credited against an unrelated-damage addition"; I read it as reducing the addition's signed price (the KB's list of credit reasons — billing error, total-loss release, repair withdrawn, addition withdrawn, goodwill — has no scan-credit reason, so no separate credit entry is described). An alternative reading (price 310.08 with a later separate credit) has no visible tool or credit reason; recorded for comparison.
- Class limit check: "Most labor hours of customer-pay work on unrelated damage per repair order" Standard = 8.0; 1.2 + 3.4 = 4.6 ≤ 8.0 → allowed.

**(b) Planned repair days (`estimated_repair_days`).**
Computation document "Planned Repair Days at Authorization": (estimated labor hours + hours of every signed customer-pay addition consent) ÷ class labor hours per production day, rounded up, + class intake and delivery days. Standard: 5.5 h/day, 1 intake day ("Production Planning Rates by Class"). Factors found:
- Hidden-damage allowance — source estimate type Photo Estimate → "scaled up by 20 percent … rounded to one decimal place": 14.6 × 1.2 = 17.52 → 17.5; "The customer-pay hours are added after this adjustment".
- Signed customer-pay hours after the signing: 1.2 + 3.4 = 4.6. Planned hours 17.5 + 4.6 = 22.1.
- Daily production hours — "more than 16.0 (two-technician minimum) | 6.5" → 22.1 > 16.0 → 6.5. Production days 22.1 / 6.5 = 3.4 → 4.
- Intake and delivery days (Standard) 1.
- Calibration days — linked Static Camera Calibration order → 1.
- Customer-pay stage days — at least one signed consent, total 4.6 ≤ 8.0 → 1 (small-addition days).
- Revision days — source estimate booking with exactly one revision → 1.
- Parts lead days — signed non-original parts disclosure (`601bf583`, signed 2026-10-08), no part-upgrade consent → 1.
- Planned repair days = 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = **9**.
- Fall-back (computation document only, after the signing): (14.6 + 4.6) / 5.5 = 3.49 → 4; + 1 → **5** (definite, different). Root-only wrong answer (no signing): (14.6 + 1.2)/5.5 = 2.87 → 3 + 1 = 4 under the baseline.

- Price at baseline 381.77: excluded by the visible factor documents (touch-up rate, no supplies, no hazardous fee, 5 % returning discount, scan credit), each tied to a record row listed above.
- Planned days 5 at baseline: excluded by the hidden-damage, daily-hours, calibration, stage, revision and parts documents, each tied to a record row.
